title: Act: Subscribe BootScene.create to transitionTo with fade-out and scene start
summary: Add a transitionTo subscription in BootScene.create that fades the camera out then starts the scene.
description: Add a private field holding the unsubscribe function and register the handler in create() next to the playAnimation subscription. The handler calls this.cameras.main.fadeOut(TRANSITION_FADE_MS) and registers a one-time listener for the camera fade-out-complete event that calls this.scene.start(sceneId).
acceptance_criteria: transitionTo emission calls cameras.main.fadeOut once with TRANSITION_FADE_MS.
scene.start(sceneId) is called only after fade-out-complete fires.

preserve: Existing create() order and shutdown handler

technical_constraints: Use reactToPhaser.on which returns an unsubscribe function

steps.action: Add an exported constant TRANSITION_FADE_MS holding the fade-out duration in milliseconds.
Add a private field next to unsubscribeAnimation to hold the transitionTo unsubscribe function.
steps.expected: Class compiles with the new field.

steps.action: After the playAnimation subscription line, subscribe to transitionTo. The handler fades the main camera out, then once on FADE_OUT_COMPLETE starts the requested scene.
steps.expected: Emitting transitionTo calls fadeOut; scene.start runs only after the fade-out-complete event.
